title: Riot Squad BLCK EDTN Rich Black Grape 50ml Shortfill E-liquid - 2 Pack
description: This Pack Contains x2 50ml Shortfills The Rich Black Grape BLCK EDTN by Riot Squad 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid is a tantalising blend of rich, ripe black grapes and a hint of cool mint. This Black Edition Rich Black Grape Riot Squad vape Shortfill is perfectly balanced to create a unique and satisfying vaping experience. Each draw is bursting with the sweet, juicy flavours of black grapes. Perfectly complemented by a refreshing mint finish. If you're a fan of fruity, refreshing E Liquids, this premium blend is sure to become your new go-to. Try Riot Squad Rich Black Grape Shortfill E-Liquid 50ml today to experience the ultimate in grape flavour satisfaction. Riot Squad’s BLCK EDTN E-Liquids are the famous vape brand’s latest leap into bold new flavour territory. These moreish vape juices are available in both Shortfill and Nic Salt E-Liquids. So whatever your vaping style, you can be sure to enjoy the delicious flavours from the Riot Squad Black Edition collection. Making it ideal for Sub-Ohm Vape Kits. As it’s the perfect E Liquid ratio for large cloud creation that doesn’t lessen your vape juice flavour. Allowing you to enjoy your favourite Riot Squad flavours to the max. Using naturally derived vegetable glycerine and propylene glycol with pharmaceutical-grade nicotine. Riot Squad’s Vape Juices are renowned for their supreme quality and ability to deliver huge flavoursome vapour clouds. So if you are looking for delicious flavour and high-quality E-Liquids for your vapes, you can be confident the Riot Squad UK-based E-Liquid manufacturer will deliver premium, flavourful vapour clouds and explosively delicious flavours in every puff! If you love this delicious Riot Squad Shortfill 50ml, then check out their other equally moreish 10ml & 50ml E-Liquids. Designed to suit any vapers flavour requirements, you’re bound to find a Riot Squad Vape juice you’ll love. Go ahead treat your taste buds to an explosion of juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverages, Confectionary/desserts, classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours from Riot Squad's delicious Black Edition, Menthol, BAR EDTN and Punx E-Liquid ranges.
